# cloudinary_trigger (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing Cloudinary webhook notification trigger. Look up by id, or by the combination of event_type and uri.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by ID.
data "cloudinary_trigger" "by_id" {
  id = "abc123"
}

# Look up by event_type + uri.
data "cloudinary_trigger" "by_event" {
  event_type = "upload"
  uri        = "https://example.com/webhooks/cloudinary"
}

output "trigger_auth_scheme" {
  value = data.cloudinary_trigger.by_event.auth_scheme
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `event_type` (String) The event that fires the trigger. Used as a lookup key together with uri when id is not set.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the trigger. When set, takes precedence over event_type + uri.
- `uri` (String) The webhook URL. Used as a lookup key together with event_type when id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `additive` (Boolean) Whether the trigger fires alongside per-asset notification_url callbacks.
- `auth_scheme` (String) Signature method for verifying webhook payloads.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the trigger was created.
- `filter` (String) JSONLogic filter expression (JSON-encoded) if configured.
- `payload_template` (String) Mustache payload template (JSON-encoded) if configured.
- `product_environment_id` (String) The product environment this trigger is scoped to.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the trigger was last updated.
- `uri_type` (String) The type of the URI. Always "webhook".
